SELECT
  ep #>> '{device,type}' AS device_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase')::numeric

FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id = 'event_benchmark'
GROUP BY ep #>> '{device,type}'

SELECT
  ep #>> '{campaign,channel}' AS campaign_channel,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase')::numeric
         / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
  END AS buyer_conversion_rate
FROM analytics.event_activity
WHERE source_id = 'event_benchmark'
GROUP BY ep #>> '{campaign,channel}'
